infoCards.title: Academic Management

infoCards.title: Administrative Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive administrative and resource management system.

faqData.question: How does the system handle student records?
faqData.answer: Our system provides secure, comprehensive student information management including academic records, attendance, behavior tracking, and progress monitoring with role-based access control.

faqData.question: Can it manage multiple academic programs?
faqData.answer: Yes, the system supports multiple programs, departments, and campuses with customizable curriculum management, scheduling, and reporting capabilities.

faqData.question: What features are available for online learning?
faqData.answer: The system includes integrated learning management features with virtual classroom support, content management, assignment tracking, and online assessment tools.
